metas.name: Black Doves
metas.description: After her lover is murdered by members of London's underworld, a spy - who is publicly the wife of the British Defence Secretary - is protected by an old friend from their agency.

metas.name: It Gets Worse
metas.description: Three best friends from college face eviction in London. As they scatter across the city, they navigate friendship, dating disasters, and adulting - all while the world crumbles around them.

metas.name: The Body
metas.description: A group of misbehaving Catholic school girls experience prophetic visions after a dance-team initiation goes wrong, triggering mass hysteria throughout their town.

metas.name: Death by Lightning
metas.description: Dramatizes the stranger-than-fiction true story of 20th U.S. President James Garfield, and admirer Charles Guiteau, who assassinated him.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2099
metas.description: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that c

metas.name: Yaga
metas.description: Follows a private investigator probing the disappearance of a young fishery heir, finding himself at odds with a local detective, a charismatic professor, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects and ancient magic.

metas.name: Hannibal
metas.description: Explores the early relationship between renowned psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter and a young FBI criminal profiler who is haunted by his ability to empathize with serial killers.

metas.name: The Prisoner
metas.description: An ex-secret agent is taken to a bizarre prison disguised as an idyllic village, from which he attempts to escape while trying not to divulge the information his captors seek to obtain.

metas.name: Nathan for You
metas.description: Nathan Fielder uses his business degree and life experiences to, in unorthodox ways, help real small businesses turn a profit.

metas.name: Garth Marenghi's Darkplace
metas.description: This parody series is an unearthed 80s horror/drama, complete with poor production values, awful dialogue and hilarious violence. The series is set in a Hospital in Romford, which is situated over the gates of Hell.

metas.name: Don't Hug Me I'm Scared
metas.description: Follow Red Guy, Yellow Guy, and Green Duck as they learn about family, electricity, and death. Beware the strange and dangerous twists that come their way as their seemingly-safe house reveals that they live in an actual nightmare.

metas.name: Sense8
metas.description: A group of people around the world are suddenly linked mentally, and must find a way to survive being hunted by those who see them as a threat to the world's order.

metas.name: Somebody Somewhere
metas.description: Sam is a true Kansan on the surface, but beneath it all she struggles to fit the hometown mold. Grappling with loss and acceptance, she discovers herself and a community of outsiders who don't fit in but don't give up.

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: The Chair Company
metas.description: Tim Robinson stars as Ron, a family man who investigates a conspiracy after an embarrassing incident at work.

metas.name: Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: The Terror
metas.description: Supernatural, semihistorical horror anthology series, where each season is inspired by a different infamous or mysterious real-life historical tragedy.

metas.name: Channel Zero
metas.description: An anthology series based on creepypastas.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

metas.name: Undone
metas.description: After she very narrowly survives a serious car accident, a woman discovers that she has a new relationship with time.

metas.name: The OA
metas.description: Having gone missing seven years ago, the previously blind Prairie returns home, now in her twenties with her sight restored. While many believe she is a miracle, others worry that she could be dangerous.

metas.name: Los Espookys
metas.description: A group of friends turns their love for horror into a peculiar business, providing horror to those who need it in a dreamy Latin American country where the strange and eerie are just part of daily life.

metas.name: It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

metas.name: The Boulet Brothers' Dragula
metas.description: Extreme drag artists from around the world compete in challenges including costume design and creation, makeup and special effects, live performance, and craftsmanship.

metas.name: Veneno
metas.description: A biographical story of TV personality and transgender icon La Veneno and those who surrounded her.
